verdict.rationale: Teams can check skills into the repository (`.agents/skills`), and Codex scans those directories up to the repo root. That means repo-scoped skill changes only reach the team through normal git commits and review, which is an implicit form of version control. For marketplace-installed plugins and `$skill-installer` skills, the docs only mention adding and tracking a marketplace source, with nothing on pinning versions, lockfiles or controlling updates. missing for 10: explicit version pinning for plugins/skills, a lockfile mechanism, documented update/upgrade controls for marketplace installs, independent corroboration.
